title: The Hunt
description: A small two-player skirmish testing light delay, orders, feedback and doctrine. Each side has a flagship, two fleets and a two-node web. Contested magnetosphere zones in the middle tempt both sides to over-extend.

players.name: Blue
players.persona: Bold and aggressive. You like decisive plays and big risks, and you get impatient with bookkeeping.

players.name: Red
players.persona: Careful and analytical. You read the rules closely, want to know exactly what each rule permits, and plan several turns ahead.
